label: boots, real frames run
js: new Promise((r) => { const f0 = game.G.frame, t0 = game.G.time; setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, frames: game.G.frame - f0, secs: +(game.G.time - t0).toFixed(2), scripts: [...document.scripts].filter((s) => s.src).length, three: typeof THREE })), 1500); })

label: ? panel freezes the game
js: game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true }); new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { const t0 = game.world().t; Kit.help.open(); setTimeout(() => { const t1 = game.world().t; Kit.help.close(); setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ open: +(t1 - t0).toFixed(2), after: +(game.world().t - t1).toFixed(2) })), 600); }, 800); }, 300))

label: checks
js: (() => { const a = game.check(), b = game.playCheck(); return JSON.stringify({ check: a.ok, play: b.ok, total: b.total, failed: b.failed.slice(0, 3) }); })()

label: sabotages
js: (() => { const f = game.checkFail(); return JSON.stringify({ allCaught: f.ok, n: f.caught.length }); })()
